senses: Combined with cha.nan.el (חֲנַנְאֵל " of Hananel" H2606)

strongs.def: a tower (from its size or height); by analogy, a rostrum; figuratively, a (pyramidal) bed of flowers
strongs.kjv: castle, flower, tower. Compare the names following
strongs.from: also (in plural) feminine מִגְדָּלָה; from H1431 (גָּדַל)
